tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search BeautySpark's makeup and colour-season guides for sections that answer a question, e.g. eyeliner for hooded eyes or how to find your undertone. Returns up to 5 sections with a short snippet and a link; read one in full with get_guide. Cite the returned url. When nothing matches, the result ha

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read one section of a BeautySpark guide in full, by an id from search_guides. Also lists the ids and headings of the other sections of the same article. Cite the returned url.

tools.name: search
tools.description: For research modes (deep research, company knowledge). In chat, use search_guides instead. Searches all public BeautySpark content: guide sections (id "<locale>/<slug>#<anchor>"), article looks (id "look:<id>") and colour-season palette pages (id "season:<season>"). Read any result with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: For research modes (deep research, company knowledge). In chat, use get_guide instead. Returns the full text of one item from search: a guide section ("<locale>/<slug>#<anchor>"), an article look ("look:<id>") or a colour-season palette page ("season:<season>").

tools.name: get_color_season
tools.description: BeautySpark's palette for one of the 12 color seasons: best, neutral and avoid colors with hex codes, plus the eye makeup and lips & cheeks advice from the season guide. Cite the returned URLs.

tools.name: get_product_picks
tools.description: BeautySpark's top product pick per category (blush, highlighter, eyeliner, lipstick, lip gloss, bronzer, eyeshadow palette) for a color season, each with the reason and the article it comes from.

tools.name: check_product_for_season
tools.description: Looks a product (and optional shade) up in BeautySpark's season picks. Returns the seasons it is recommended for, or match: null when BeautySpark has not reviewed it; then do not present any verdict as BeautySpark's. Pass season to also get that season's palette for comparison.

tools.name: find_article_looks
tools.description: Find makeup looks shown in BeautySpark articles, filtered by color season, article type and words. With a season, looks made for that season come first; general looks (no season) follow and are labelled. Returns look ids for get_article_look and the article URL to cite.

tools.name: get_article_look
tools.description: Get the steps and shades of one makeup look from a BeautySpark article. The id is a look id returned by find_article_looks ("/images/blog/<article-slug>/<look-name>").

tools.name: search_my_looks
tools.description: Search the user's saved looks in BeautySpark My Looks by words, tag, category, favourite or person. Returns look ids for get_my_look.

tools.name: get_my_look
tools.description: Get one saved look in full: steps, products and shades, tags, categories, notes, photos and a link to open it in BeautySpark.

tools.name: save_my_look
tools.description: Save a new look to the user's BeautySpark My Looks. Photos can't be added from chat: if the user attached or mentions a photo, tell them before saving that only the text is saved and that they can add the photo in BeautySpark from the returned link. Repeating the same save within 10 minutes returns

tools.name: update_my_look
tools.description: Change a saved look. Only the fields you send change; list fields (steps, products, tags, categories, occasions) replace the stored list whole. Look photos are kept. Steps can't be changed while any step has a photoUrl; the user edits those steps in the BeautySpark app. When the look's steps link pr

tools.name: delete_my_look
tools.description: Delete a saved look from the user's BeautySpark My Looks. The look is removed.

tools.name: save_generation_to_my_looks
tools.description: Save a finished BeautySpark generation (a jobId from list_my_generations) as a look in My Looks. Saving the same generation again returns the look already saved.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: The user's BeautySpark analysis: color season, undertone, eye shape, face shape and app language. Fields are null until the selfie analysis has been run in the app.

tools.name: list_my_palettes
tools.description: The palettes the user scanned in BeautySpark, with shade names and hex colors. Use them to advise with products the user owns; pass a paletteId as a product's userPaletteId in save_my_look.

tools.name: list_my_generations
tools.description: The user's finished BeautySpark look generations, newest first: title, date, thumbnail and whether it is already in My Looks. Pass a jobId to save_generation_to_my_looks to save one.

tools.name: try_look_from_photo
tools.description: Prepare a try-on: BeautySpark recreates a makeup look on the user's selfie. Give one reference: articleLookId (from find_article_looks) or savedLookId (from search_my_looks). Photos (a reference photo or a different selfie) can only be uploaded in the try-on widget, never taken from chat attachments

tools.name: confirm_look_generation
tools.description: Start the try-on prepared by try_look_from_photo. This spends the BeautySpark credits it quoted. The try-on widget calls it when the user presses Confirm. If no widget is showing, ask the user to confirm the cost first and call it only after they agree. Calling it again for the same quote returns th

tools.name: get_look_status
tools.description: Check a try-on started by confirm_look_generation. Waits up to waitSeconds (at most 25) for it to finish before answering. When completed, the result includes the image URL and, when the look has them, its step-by-step instructions with the colours for each step.

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.description: Used by the try-on widget to upload a photo the user picked. Returns an upload URL valid for 15 minutes.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_look_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check a try-on started by confirm_look_generation. Waits up to waitSeconds (at most 25) for it to finish before answering. When completed, the result includes t…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide, search, fetch, get_color_season, get_look_status · Public sink: update_my_look, create_upload_url · Destructive: delete_my_look, get_my_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, get_guide, search, fetch, get_color_season, get_look_status · Public sink: update_my_look, create_upload_url · Destructive: delete_my_look, get_my_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
